tasks.label: Compilar e Rodar Asm OS
args: nasm -f bin "${workspaceFolder}/inicio.asm" -o "${workspaceFolder}/inicio.bin" && nasm -f bin "${workspaceFolder}/kernel.asm" -o "${workspaceFolder}/kernel" && nasm -f bin "${workspaceFolder}/video.asm" -o "${workspaceFolder}/video.dr" && dd if=/dev/zero of="${workspaceFolder}/disco.img" bs=512 count=1048576 2>/dev/null && dd if="${workspaceFolder}/inicio.bin" of="${workspaceFolder}/disco.img" bs=512 count=1 conv=notrunc 2>/dev/null && dd if="${workspaceFolder}/kernel" of="${workspaceFolder}/disco.img" bs=512 seek=1 conv=notrunc 2>/dev/null && dd if="${workspaceFolder}/video.dr" of="${workspaceFolder}/disco.img" bs=512 seek=6 conv=notrunc 2>/dev/null && qemu-system-x86_64 -fda "${workspaceFolder}/disco.img" -boot a -m 32 -display gtk
